integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for alg-geom/9611033 gives 1996-11-26, and the later paper states that the results first appeared on alg-geom in November 1996.

scientific_limitations: General complex hypersurfaces in the critical zero-dimensional plane regime only.
The real corollary is restricted to the transverse zero-dimensional real locus.
The theorem classifies parity, not the full 2-adic valuation in even cases.
Higher-dimensional linear spaces and multihypersurface complete intersections are not treated.
title: Only quintic and septic critical hypersurfaces have an odd number of planes
